card.name: Japanese organization names, middle words
card.fires_on: The middle word of an organization name in text about Japan, such as Radio, Technology, Atomic or International. It also fires on radio and care in nearby passages.

modes.label: Japanese company or club names
modes.description: A noun inside the name of a Japanese company, club or press, right after a Japan-linked name.
modes.example: from the Meisei Electric Company<< Radio>> Club, Japan, will send CW telemetry

modes.label: Government or institution titles
modes.description: A word in a Japanese award, agency or ministry title.
modes.example: the Japanese government created the<< International>> Manga Award to recognise non-Japanese creators

modes.label: Radio and care as nouns
modes.description: The word radio or care used as a modifier before station or facilities.
modes.example: In hospitals and<< care>> facilities, some people only have two baths

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning part or corresponding, which suggests it favors a name continuing rather than a part-of reference.
card.plain: It marks a word inside a Japanese organization's name, such as the Radio in a radio club's name.
